nameEn: Cutting, shaping and finishing of stone
description: This class includes the cutting, shaping and finishing of stone for construction and other purposes.
includes: cutting, shaping and finishing of stone for construction: flagstones, kerbstones, slabs, columns
manufacture of stone setts, curbs, cobbles and other stone for paving
manufacture of articles of stone or of other mineral substances: millstones, grindstones, abrasive wheels, monuments, furniture
manufacture of stone for laboratory, industrial or other use
